name: A Single Card

positions.name: The Answer
frames: The cards give you one answer, and it is {card}: {essence}.
I turn a single card, and it speaks of {essence}.

openings: One card, then. Let us see what it holds.
A single question deserves a single answer. Here it is.
Hush. One card is enough, if it is the right one.

name: Past, Present, Future
desc: Three cards laid left to right.

positions.name: The Past
frames: In what you have left behind, I see {essence}.
Your past is marked by {card}. It speaks of {essence}.

positions.name: The Present
frames: In your present I see {card}, and with it {essence}.

positions.name: The Future
frames: {card} waits in what is to come: {essence}.
What lies before you, if nothing changes, is {essence}.

openings: Three cards: where you come from, where you stand, where you go.
Let us follow the thread from its beginning.
The cards lie in a row, like a road. Let me walk it for you.

name: The Cross
desc: Five cards: the matter, what lies behind and ahead, above and below.

positions.name: The Heart of the Matter
frames: At the heart of the matter lies {card}: {essence}.
{card} sits at the centre of it all: {essence}.
At the very heart of your question, I see {essence}.

positions.name: What Lies Behind
frames: Behind it, {card} still casts its shadow: {essence}.

positions.name: What Crowns It
frames: At best, it crowns itself in {essence}.
Above it all hangs {card}, what you hope for or fear the most: {essence}.

positions.name: What Lies Beneath
frames: {card} lies under everything, at its root: {essence}.
What you do not say aloud is {essence}.

openings: Five cards, and you at their centre. Let us begin with the heart.
The cross is laid. Every arm of it speaks of you.
This is an old spread, and it does not lie easily. Listen.

name: The Two Moons
desc: Mel’Tara turns quickly, Ior’Tara slowly. One question between them, and what each moon brings and takes away.

positions.name: The Night Sky
positions.desc: the question, and where you stand
frames: Between the two moons, your question: {essence}.
The night sky holds {card}, and with it {essence}.

positions.name: Mel’Tara Waxing
frames: Mel’Tara is waxing, and soon it brings {essence}.
The quick moon brings {card} before the month is out: {essence}.
Within a turn of Mel’Tara, I see {essence}.

positions.name: Mel’Tara Waning
frames: As Mel’Tara wanes, it takes away {essence}.
Soon gone, and not for long, is {essence}.

positions.name: Ior’Tara Waxing
frames: Ior’Tara rises slowly, and over the seasons it brings {essence}.
The slow moon is bringing {card}: {essence}. It will take its time.

positions.name: Ior’Tara Waning
frames: Ior’Tara wanes, and slowly takes from you {essence}.
The slow moon is taking {card} away: {essence}.

openings: Two moons tonight, and both have something to say.
Mel’Tara hurries, Ior’Tara lingers. Let us see what each brings.
Look up with me. The moons do not lie, they only take their time.

name: The Judgement of Souls
desc: Every soul goes down to the Underworld before it is judged. Where would yours go, if it were weighed today?

positions.name: The Underworld
positions.desc: where you stand, not yet judged
frames: Your soul waits in the Underworld with {card}: {essence}.
Down in the Underworld, I see {essence}.

positions.name: The Road to Aran
frames: The road to Aran opens through {essence}.

positions.name: The Road to Tartarus
frames: The road to Tartarus runs through {essence}.
{card} waits on the road to Tartarus: {essence}.

openings: Every soul is weighed in the end. Let us weigh yours a little early.
The dead do not lie to the judges. Neither will the cards.
Down we go, then. The Underworld is patient.

name: The Dreamlands Thread
desc: The Dreamlands touch every plane. Follow the thread from the sleeper to the waking.

positions.name: The Dream You Have
frames: What you long for, when no one is watching, is {essence}.

positions.name: The Dream That Has You
positions.desc: what holds you without your knowing
frames: But a dream has you too: {essence}.
{card} dreams you, not the other way round: {essence}.
What holds you without your knowing is {essence}.

positions.name: The Thread
frames: What links them, like a thread through the planes, is {essence}.

positions.name: The Waking
frames: When you wake, you bring back {essence}.

openings: Close your eyes. The Dreamlands are closer than you think.
Every plane dreams, and every dream leads somewhere. Let us follow this one.
Hush. We are going to walk where sleepers walk.

name: The Eight Days
desc: One card for each day of the coming week, from Protasten to Egtosten.

positions.name: Protasten
positions.desc: the first day of the week: what it brings

positions.name: Deftesten
positions.desc: the second day: what it brings

positions.name: Traensten
positions.desc: the third day: what it brings

positions.name: Tertasten
positions.desc: the fourth day: what it brings

positions.name: Pemtasten
positions.desc: the fifth day: what it brings

positions.name: Eksten
positions.desc: the sixth day: what it brings

positions.name: Evodosten
positions.desc: the seventh day: what it brings

positions.name: Egtosten
positions.desc: the last day of the week: what it brings

openings: Eight days in a week, eight cards on the table. Let us see what the week holds.
A whole week, laid out in a circle. Mind the days that frown.
From Protasten to Egtosten, then. Day by day.

name: The Mobius Loop
desc: Mobius touches every plane and turns back on itself. What you did, what it caused, and what brings you back to the start.

positions.name: The Far Turn
frames: At the far end of the loop lies {essence}.
As far as it goes, it goes to {essence}.

positions.name: The Way Back
frames: Then the loop bends back through {essence}.

positions.name: What Brings You Back
positions.desc: what returns you to the start
frames: What brings you back where you began is {essence}.
You return to the start through {essence}.

openings: What goes around comes around. Let us see how far around.
This one is a loop. Watch where it closes.
Everything here leads back to you, sooner or later.

name: The Void Between
desc: Where you are, where you want to be, and what lies in the dark between them.

positions.name: Where You Want to Be
frames: Where you want to be, {card} waits: {essence}.

positions.name: What Lies Between
frames: Between the two, in the Void, lies {essence}.
To cross, you must go through {essence}.

openings: Two shores and the dark between them. Let us look at all three.
Between every plane lies the Void. Between you and what you want, too.
Mind the gap. It is wider than it looks.
